title: The Twin-Strike Falls
summary: The meadow's apex strayling goes down, and the expedition finally sees past the tent line.

title: Icefield-Thornveil Standoff
summary: With the Stoneguard's line broken, Thornveil scouts test the opening from across the frontier.

title: The First Caravan Burns
summary: A caravan burns on the Ashvale road at dawn, and each side of the plain is already certain who lit it.

title: War Declared
summary: Embervale and Norhollow name each other the enemy, and the Ashvale plain becomes a front.

title: Refuge at Millcross
summary: The first wave of families off the Ashvale road reaches Millcross, and doesn't stop coming.

title: The Seal That Matched No One
summary: A caravan seal salvaged from the ash doesn't belong to either side of the war — the first crack in the story everyone believes.

title: Farrow Falls
summary: Farrow the Forward holds the near bank of the ford alone so the last of the column can cross.
